Earspoon is a dwarven member of the Rivington rats visiting Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing. He is whispering to  Borgus Elamin.
“
I want to be sandwiched between a pair of nymphs.
„
— Earspoon when asked about Nine-Fingers

History

According to Wyrm's Rock Prison's  Prison Log, Earspoon was previously arrested for indecent exposure but was released by  Enver Gortash.

Involvement

Earspoon is whispering to Borgus in the rear of Sharess' Caress. Approaching them triggers a passive  DC 15 History Check (with Rogues and Baldurians having advantage) and a  DC 10 Deception Check or  DC 15 Perception Check to determine they are talking about  Nine-Fingers Keene. The party can then ask Earspoon where Nine-Fingers is by passing one of these ability checks:

  • [PERSUASION] Come on, level with me. I'm not about to sell out another dwarf. (DC 15)
  • [PERSUASION] I bet a few coins would loosen your tongue. (DC 15)
  • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] I'm looking to join the Guild. How about you point me the way? (DC 18 )
  • [FIGHTER] [PERSUASION] I need work, and it sounds like Nine-Fingers needs steel.  (DC 18 )
  • [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM] Read the dwarf's mind.
    • I need to talk to Nine-Fingers about Zenovia.
